violation_type.title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))
violation_type.typical_finding: The Children's Product Certification is not posted for staff and parents to review any products that have been recalled. This was corrected at inspection and posted.

finding_variants.text: The Children's Product Certification is not posted for staff and parents to review any products that have been recalled. This was corrected at inspection and posted.
CPSC signed notification has not been completed since 9/2022.
At the time of inspection the opertion did not have a current CPSC paperowork on file.
The director has not signed up and certified to receive email notices from the CPSC.
The last documented annual certification that the operation reviewed the CPSC recall list and certified that there is no recalled items in the center was observed in 2021.
The Children's Product Certification Form was not available at the time of the inspection.
